checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 8 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=18 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=2 giveback=0.27 tightness=0.71 base_volume_vs_leg=1.12 base_volume_vs_avg=1.0
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 5.0% vs its 20-SMA, 2.2% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 3 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The Y check is a hard FAIL with 7 prior breakouts in this move over 60 sessions — today would be breakout number 8 of a trend that has already gained 45.6% since its start, which is the single most decisive flaw visible in the chart: the price has made repeated visible pushes from the mid-$30s through the mid-$50s with no fresh base at a new stage. The base itself shows two bursts inside and a tightness of 0.71 that barely passes, and the chart confirms a choppy, overlapping consolidation box with multiple red and green bars of similar size rather than a truly quiet shelf.
claude.key_risk: This is the eighth breakout attempt of an extended move; prior breakouts worked only 1 of 3 times, and repeated pushes at this stage dramatically increase the odds of a failed follow-through.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the signal day's high or if the first 30 minutes show price retreating back below the prior base high near $55.
